scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} sits in your office with {his} hood up. Three losses in a row. 'I think I'm done, boss. My hands don't listen anymore.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Send {him} to a new camp, your treat ({$fee})
choices.result: {He} packs a bag for a gym in the mountains run by a man who only communicates in grunts.

choices.label: Book {him} a softer opponent
choices.result: A tune-up fight. Everybody knows what it is. Nobody says it out loud.

choices.label: Suggest retirement
choices.result: {He} leaves without a word. {He} doesn't retire. {He} just stops answering your calls.

scenes.text: {subject.first} posts from the mountain camp: chopping wood, carrying rocks uphill, sparring a guy named Grizz who has never lost a street fight or a tooth. {He} looks... different. Hungry.

choices.label: Book {him} against a ranked name
choices.result: The fans call it a mismatch. {He} calls it Tuesday.

choices.label: Let {him} take another tune-up
choices.result: {He} wins easy. {He} wanted harder.

scenes.text: The tune-up opponent showed up 14 pounds heavy and smelling of beer. {subject.first} wins in 40 seconds. Nobody is impressed. {He} isn't either.

choices.label: Fine. Give {him} a real test next.
choices.result: {He} nods. That's the first time {he}'s nodded in months.

scenes.text: THE COMEBACK IS REAL: {subject.last} looks like a new fighter. Social media is calling it 'the redemption arc', 'the glow up' and, for some reason, 'the {pop_movie} montage'.

choices.label: Give {him} a raise and a contract extension
choices.result: {He} signs and hugs you for slightly too long.

choices.label: Ride the hype into a title eliminator
choices.result: One more win and {he}'s fighting for gold. The documentary crew is already following {him}.

scenes.text: {subject.first} wants to drop a weight class. {He} walks around 38 pounds over the new limit. {His} nutritionist has resigned. {His} new nutritionist is a guy from the gym who 'read a lot about water'.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Approve the move down
choices.result: {He} starts living in a sauna suit. Neighbors report a 'sweaty ghost' jogging at night.

choices.label: Make {him} hire a real nutritionist ({$fee})
choices.result: The real nutritionist cries a little when she sees {his} meal plan. Then she fixes it.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.result: {He} stays put and complains about being 'the smallest heavy guy in the world'.

scenes.text: Weigh-in morning. {subject.first} is grey, shaking, and has asked twice what year it is. The scale reads exactly the limit. {He} raises both arms and nearly faints into the commission inspector.

choices.label: Get {him} IV fluids and a doctor
choices.result: {He} rehydrates 17 pounds overnight. The opponent looks like a child next to {him}.

choices.label: Leave it. {He} made weight.
choices.result: {He} looks rough. {He} fights rough.

title: The Kid Everyone Is Talking About

scenes.text: A 19-year-old named {subject.first} {subject.last} has a highlight reel going viral: six first-round finishes, one of them with a cartwheel kick. {He}'s on your roster. Rival promotions are already DMing {him} fire emojis.

choices.label: Lock {him} into a long contract now
choices.result: {His} mom signs as a witness. She cries. {He} asks if the contract comes with a car.

choices.label: Let {him} develop slowly
choices.result: Slow and steady. {His} manager thinks slow and steady is for tortoises.

scenes.text: Is {subject.last} the future of the sport? The kid has done 14 interviews this week, a cereal ad, and a podcast with {pop_streamer}. {He} hasn't trained in nine days.

choices.label: Shut the media tour down
choices.result: {He} sulks, then trains. Then sulks while training.

choices.label: More media. Strike while hot.
choices.result: {He} gasses in round two next time. But the cereal sells out.

scenes.text: A rival promotion offered {subject.first} triple {his} purse plus a signing bonus 'in crypto'. {He} hasn't said yes. {He} hasn't said no. {He} sent you a screenshot with a thinking emoji.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Match it
choices.result: Expensive. {He} stays. {His} manager buys a boat.

choices.label: Call the bluff
choices.result: Sometimes the bluff works. Sometimes the kid becomes someone else's future.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last}, {subject.age}, sets {his} old gloves on your desk. 'Give me three more fights. If I lose one, I walk. If I win them all, I want a title shot.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Deal
choices.result: You shake on it. {His} handshake is still terrifying.

choices.label: Offer a coaching job instead
choices.result: 'Coaching is for people who can't fight.' {He} leaves. {He} comes back the next day to ask about the dental plan.

scenes.text: {subject.first} is two fights into the last run and looks ten years younger. {His} knees look twenty years older. The fans have started chanting {his} name at the weigh-ins.

choices.label: Promote the hell out of it
choices.result: 'THE LAST RUN' trends for a week. {He} pretends not to read it. {He} reads all of it.

choices.label: Quietly have the doctors check {him}
choices.result: The doctors say {he}'s fine for {his} age. They say 'for your age' four times.

scenes.text: {subject.first} comes by after {his} last fight of the run, win or lose, with a framed photo of {him} and you at {his} first fight. 'Thank you. I'm done. I mean it this time.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Throw {him} a retirement ceremony in the cage
choices.result: The whole arena stands. {He} leaves the gloves in the center of the cage. Juiced Butler cries. Juiced Butler denies crying.

choices.label: 'One more?'
choices.result: {He} laughs. Then {he} thinks about it. Oh no.

scenes.text: Grainy phone footage from a closed gym: {subject.first} getting dropped in sparring by {other.first} {other.last}. 3 million views. {subject.last} insists {he} 'tripped on a kettlebell'.

choices.label: Make the fight for real
choices.result: Now it's personal. The kettlebell is reportedly 'staying neutral'.

choices.label: Find out who leaked it
choices.result: You start an investigation. The gym's WiFi password was 'password'.

scenes.text: The leaker was {other.last}'s cousin, who ran a fan account and 'thought it was cool'. {subject.last} wants him banned from all events. {other.last} wants him promoted to social media manager.

choices.label: Ban the cousin
choices.result: The cousin posts a 40-tweet thread about it. More views than the fight.

choices.label: Hire the cousin
choices.result: He's great at it. Unbelievably great. You hate how good he is.

scenes.text: At the press conference, {other.first} brings a kettlebell and sets it on the table. {subject.first} picks it up, looks at it, and throws it into the crowd. Nobody is hurt. A reporter keeps it.

choices.label: Fine {subject.last} (publicly)
choices.result: {He} pays the fine in coins. Seventy pounds of coins.

choices.label: Sell kettlebell merch
choices.result: Signed kettlebells sell out in an hour. Shipping costs are a nightmare.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s father has appointed himself 'head coach, manager and spiritual adviser'. He's wearing a headset. Nobody gave him a headset.
scenes.speaker: {subject.first}'s dad

choices.label: Let dad run the corner
choices.result: Dad's first instruction is 'HIT HIM'. Second is 'HIT HIM HARDER'. Strategy.

choices.label: Politely remove dad
choices.result: Dad leaves. Dad will remember.

scenes.text: Between rounds, {subject.first}'s dad slaps {him} across the face 'to wake him up', yells at the cutman, and argues with the ring card girl about the round number. The broadcast picks it all up.

choices.label: Let it ride. It's great TV.
choices.result: The clip goes everywhere. Dad starts a podcast.

choices.label: Replace dad with a real coach
choices.result: Dad watches from the stands. Loudly.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s dad has started a rival gym across the street and is telling anyone who listens that {president} 'stole his son'. He's also selling T-shirts. They're good T-shirts.

choices.label: Make peace: invite him to the next event
choices.result: Dad comes. Dad behaves. Dad sneaks into the cage after the fight to hug his boy.

choices.label: Ignore him
choices.result: The T-shirt says '{presidentLast} OWES ME A SANDWICH'. It's everywhere.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} has finished five straight opponents and gives post-fight interviews in a whisper. Fans love the fights. Marketing is losing its mind. The kid just wants to go home and play {pop_game}.

choices.label: Hire a media coach ({$fee})
choices.result: The media coach's first exercise is 'say your own name loudly'. It takes two days.

choices.label: Lean into it: 'The Silent Assassin'
choices.result: Merch with a finger over lips. It sells. {He} still won't do interviews.

scenes.text: {subject.first}'s first big interview: a sit-down with Joe Brogan. Four hours. {He} says eleven words. Three of them are 'yeah'. The internet decides it's the most mysterious interview of all time.

choices.label: Embrace the mystery
choices.result: The mystery becomes the brand. Brogan does a three-hour episode about the eleven words.

choices.label: Keep coaching
choices.result: By the next presser, {he} says a full sentence. It's 'I'm going to win'. The crowd erupts.

scenes.text: Training partners {subject.first} {subject.last} and {other.first} {other.last} are ranked one and two. They walk in together, holding the same protein shake. 'We don't fight each other. Ever.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} & {other.first}

choices.label: Respect it
choices.result: Fans call it cowardice. The two of them call it brotherhood. You call it a headache.

choices.label: Offer them both double to fight
choices.result: They look at each other. They look at the number. They look at each other again.

other.where: f.ours && f.id != subject.id && f.division == subject.division && f.gym == subject.gym

scenes.text: {subject.first} unfollowed {other.first}. {other.first} posted a cryptic quote about 'snakes in the garden'. Their gym has split down the middle. Even the gym cat had to pick a side.

choices.label: Book it
choices.result: Former best friends. The promo writes itself. The cat attends the weigh-in.

choices.label: Try to repair it
choices.result: You buy them lunch. They split the bill. Small progress.

other.where: f.ours && f.id != subject.id && f.division == subject.division && f.gym == subject.gym

scenes.text: {pop_streamer} has called out {subject.first} {subject.last} for 'a real fight, no headgear, winner gets the loser's car'. The video has 14 million views. {subject.last} replied with a single word: 'bet'.

choices.label: Sanction the exhibition
choices.result: Purists hate it. Everyone watches it.

choices.label: Forbid it
choices.result: {He} responds 'bet' to you as well. You're not sure what that means.

scenes.text: The influencer walks out on a hoverboard with a 40-person entourage. {subject.first} walks out alone. It lasts 31 seconds. The influencer's car is a {pop_car}.

choices.label: Let {subject.first} keep the car
choices.result: {He} drives it to every press conference for a year.

choices.label: Auction the car for charity
choices.result: It sells for a fortune to a man who wants to 'feel what it felt'.

scenes.text: Your cutman pulls you aside: {subject.first} has been limping out of practice all week and icing a knee in the parking lot so nobody sees. {He} fights in two weeks.

choices.label: Send {him} for an MRI
choices.result: {He} goes, swearing the whole way.

choices.label: Don't ask, don't tell
choices.result: The show must go on. The knee must go on.

scenes.text: MRI RESULTS: partial MCL tear. Recommended rest: 6-8 weeks. Fighter's handwritten note in margin: 'its fine'.
scenes.title: MEDICAL IMAGING REPORT

choices.label: Pull {him} from the card
choices.result: {He} is furious. {His} knee is relieved.

choices.label: Let {him} fight with a brace
choices.result: The brace is visible on the broadcast. Blow Hogan talks about it for an entire round.

scenes.text: Round one. {subject.first} plants to throw a hook and the knee simply leaves. The crowd groans. Lon Anik says 'oh no' in a voice you've never heard before.

choices.label: Pay all the surgery costs
choices.result: Expensive. Correct.

choices.label: Point to the waiver {he} signed
choices.result: The whole roster saw that.

scenes.text: {subject.first} is launching a clothing line called '{subject.nick} Wear'. The first item is a hoodie with {his} own face on it, crying. 'It's ironic,' {he} explains.

choices.label: Partner with {him} on it
choices.result: Your logo goes on the sleeve. Next to the crying face.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: {He} launches it alone. The website crashes.

scenes.text: {subject.last}'s crying-face hoodie becomes an unexpected hit; spotted on {pop_celeb} at an airport.

choices.label: Take your cut
choices.result: Ironic hoodies: the future of combat sports revenue.

choices.label: Let {him} keep it all
choices.result: {He} buys {his} mom a house. {His} mom wears the hoodie.

scenes.text: {subject.gym} and {other.gym} are at war. Someone keyed a car. Someone stole the other gym's mascot (a large inflatable gorilla named Kevin). Both gyms have fighters on your next card.

choices.label: Book them against each other
choices.result: Gym vs gym. Kevin the gorilla will be cageside.

choices.label: Mediate
choices.result: You set up a summit. At a Denny's.

other.where: f.ours && f.booked && f.gym != subject.gym && f.division == subject.division

scenes.text: Both head coaches meet at a Denny's at 2am. Within 15 minutes, there's a dispute over the last pancake. Within 16, there's a truce: Kevin goes back, and both gyms ban the car keyer.

choices.label: Celebrate the peace
choices.result: Peace in our time. Kevin is returned with a new hat.

other.where: f.ours && f.booked && f.gym != subject.gym && f.division == subject.division

scenes.text: Both gyms fill opposite sections of the arena. Chants go back and forth all night. Kevin the gorilla is inflated cageside and deflated by security twice.

choices.label: Embrace the chaos
choices.result: Best atmosphere of the year. The cleaning crew disagrees.

choices.label: Add security
choices.result: Calm, orderly, slightly less fun.

other.where: f.ours && f.booked && f.gym != subject.gym && f.division == subject.division

scenes.text: {subject.first} has a new 'performance guru' who believes in raw eggs, sunlight on the testicles, and sleeping upside down. {subject.last} says {he} 'has never felt better'. {He} looks yellow.

choices.label: Allow it, it's {his} life
choices.result: {He} starts posting sunrise videos. Shirtless. Pantless. The algorithm hides them.

choices.label: Ban the guru from camp
choices.result: The guru calls you 'an enemy of the sun'.

scenes.text: {subject.first} has salmonella. The guru says it's 'detox'. The doctor says it's salmonella. {He} has a fight in three weeks.

choices.label: Pull {him} and fire the guru
choices.result: The guru leaves on a skateboard. {He} recovers on toast.

choices.label: Fight anyway
choices.result: {He} fights pale, and loses the third round to his own stomach.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} slams a stack of printed rankings on your desk. 'Four in a row. I'm next. If I'm not next, I'm gone.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Promise {him} the next shot
choices.result: {He} leaves calm. Calm-ish. {He} kicks a vending machine on the way out, but calmly.

choices.label: Make {him} take one more fight
choices.result: 'One more' is the most hated phrase in the sport. You just said it.

scenes.text: {subject.first} calls: 'Ten weeks. You promised. I've been counting. My kid has been counting. My kid made a calendar.'
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Deliver: book the title fight
choices.result: {His} kid crosses off the last day on the calendar. Everyone is happy, except the champ.

choices.label: Delay again
choices.result: {He} posts the calendar. With a big red X. 4 million views.

scenes.text: {subject.last} REFUSES TO FIGHT UNTIL GIVEN TITLE SHOT; posts video training alone in a parking garage

choices.label: Give in
choices.result: {He} wins the standoff. The rest of the roster takes notes.

choices.label: Release {him}
choices.result: {He} signs with a rival within the week. Of course.

scenes.text: A polite man named Sal says {subject.first} owes 'some friends' a large amount from 'cards'. Sal wants you to know he's a big fan. Sal also knows where your car is parked.
scenes.speaker: Sal

choices.label: Pay the marker quietly ({$fee})
choices.result: Sal sends a fruit basket. The fruit basket is threatening somehow.

choices.label: Get {him} into a recovery program
choices.result: {He} goes to meetings. {He} bets on how long the meetings last. Baby steps.

choices.label: Not your problem
choices.result: Sal is disappointed. Sal's disappointment has consequences.

scenes.text: Sal again. 'Your guy has a new marker. Bigger. I'm starting to feel like family. Do you feel like family?'
scenes.speaker: Sal

choices.label: Recovery program, mandatory this time
choices.result: This time it sticks. Mostly. {He} bets on football once. Only once.

choices.label: Pay it again
choices.result: Sal adds you to his Christmas card list.

scenes.text: {subject.first} posts: 'I will KO {other.last} in the first round with a left hook. Screenshot this.' 2 million people screenshot it.

choices.label: Hype it everywhere
choices.result: Every commercial ends with 'SCREENSHOT THIS'.

choices.label: Tell {him} to tone it down
choices.result: {He} posts 'toning it down' followed by 47 fire emojis.

scenes.text: {subject.last}'s 'SCREENSHOT THIS' prediction resurfaces before the fight. Bookmakers report record bets on a round-one KO. One man bet his boat.

choices.label: Ride it
choices.result: Whatever happens, the internet wins.
